title: Accessibility Services — Meals for an Attendant Travelling with a RideLink Member
content:
A member who needs an attendant on a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation long-distance stay may have the attendant's meals paid as a share of the member's own meals.

**Rule.** The attendant who travels with the member is paid meals as a share of the member's meals: the full attendant share of 1.0 when the member holds an approved or expired Durable Medical Equipment Authorization for a standard manual wheelchair, service code K0001, and the active Medicaid Managed Care Membership is in Prairie Ridge ABD Care or Prairie Ridge Dual Complete; the half attendant share of 0.5 when exactly one of those two holds; and no attendant share when neither holds.

The attendant's meals are the member's whole meals amount for the stay times the attendant share, paid in addition to the member's meals. The share applies to meals only.

The wheelchair authorization is read from the member's Prior Authorization records: an authorization of the Durable Medical Equipment Authorization class for service code K0001, in approved or expired status. The eligibility category is the one on the member's active membership.

## Truth table

| K0001 wheelchair authorization approved or expired | Membership in Prairie Ridge ABD Care or Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | Attendant share of the member's meals |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 1.0, the full share |
| Yes | No | 0.5, the half share |
| No | Yes | 0.5, the half share |
| No | No | None |

## Worked figures

*Hypothetical member meals of 75.00 USD for the stay:*

- full share: the attendant's meals are 75.00 USD, so the meals come to 150.00 USD;
- half share: the attendant's meals are 37.50 USD, so the meals come to 112.50 USD;
- no share: the meals stay at 75.00 USD.

An authorization for another service code, or one in a status other than approved or expired, does not satisfy the first condition.
